Class HudBuilder

java.lang.Object
au.ellie.hyui.builders.InterfaceBuilder<HudBuilder>
au.ellie.hyui.builders.HudBuilder
public class HudBuilder extends InterfaceBuilder<HudBuilder>
Builder for HUDs (Heads-Up Displays) that persist on the player's screen. Supports periodic refreshes and multi-HUD stacking behavior.
